secrets.name: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY
secrets.description: DeepSeek API key for AI task generation/execution. Get it from https://platform.deepseek.com — required for AI features to work.

secrets.name: COMPOSIO_API_KEY
secrets.description: Composio API key for Gmail/Calendar/Drive integrations. Get it from https://composio.dev — required for integration features to work.

secrets.name: SESSION_SECRET
secrets.description: Long random string to sign session cookies (e.g. `openssl rand -hex 32`). Only required in production.

secrets.name: CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY
secrets.description: AES-256-GCM key to encrypt the Pronote login token. Without it, Pronote connect refuses to run. Generate with `openssl rand -hex 32`.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL for cloud persistence. Run supabase.sql in the Supabase SQL editor first.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service key (bypasses RLS, server-side only). Required for cloud persistence and login/signup to work.
